## Dead West Railway Classic

This version renames the game to **Dead West Railway Classic**. Nothing in the game changes: your saves, stations and settings come through as they were, it keeps updating from this page, and it plays on the same server.

The new Dead West Railway, where the game goes on from here, is a separate game with its own downloads: [Joshspeakman/dead-west-railway-cs](https://github.com/Joshspeakman/dead-west-railway-cs/releases).

## Download

Download the file for your system:

| System                                      | File                          |
| ------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------- |
| Windows 10 or 11                            | `Dead-West-Railway-Setup.exe` |
| macOS 13 or newer (Apple Silicon and Intel) | `Dead-West-Railway.dmg`       |
| Linux: Ubuntu, Debian, Mint, Pop!\_OS       | `dead-west-railway_amd64.deb` |
| Linux: any other distribution               | `Dead-West-Railway.AppImage`  |

Windows and macOS ask you to confirm the first time you open the game. The steps are in the [install guide](https://github.com/Joshspeakman/dead-west-railway#install).
